kings-island: mobility

The guide lists transfer devices available on request at Banshee, Beast, Racer, Mystic Timbers, The Bat and Woodstock Express. Ask the ride team how a device is used and whether it suits the intended transfer; the listing does not promise staff lifting.
https://media.qrtiger.com/files/2026/04/web-pdf---ki-26-0003-guest-accessibility-guide.pdf
operator_official

T ransfer devices, when requested, can be used to assist a Guest out of a wheelchair and into a ride unit. The following rides are equipped with a transfer device: Banshee, Beast, Racer, Mystic Timbers, The Bat, and Woodstock Express.

Kings Island personnel are not trained in transferring Guests from wheelchairs to ride units and are not permitted to do so. Y ou should plan your visit with someone who can physically help you when necessary.
mobility

The guide identifies ride vehicles with removable sides at Queen City Stunt Coaster and SNOOPY’S Soap Box Racers to help with wheelchair-to-seat transfers. Tell an associate at the ride if you want to use that vehicle; riders still need to meet its eligibility criteria.
https://media.qrtiger.com/files/2026/04/web-pdf---ki-26-0003-guest-accessibility-guide.pdf
operator_official

Specific ride vehicles are equipped with removable sides at Queen City Stunt Coaster and SNOOPY’S™ Soap Box Racers. These vehicles may further assist Riders in transferring from their wheelchair to the ride unit. Please inform an Associate at the ride if you wish to use that vehicle.
All Guests are required to meet all riding requirements for every attraction, including height and health restrictions in order to safely ride/participate.

On most rides, a service animal must stay with a non-riding member of the visitor’s party. Kings Island says staff are not permitted to take control of the animal; ask Guest Services about Rider Swap rather than assuming staff can provide animal care.
https://media.qrtiger.com/files/2026/04/web-pdf---ki-26-0003-guest-accessibility-guide.pdf
operator_official
Due to the nature of most rides, service animals must remain with a non-Riding member of your party. We are not permitted to take control of your service animal.
Guests may take advantage of our Rider Swap policy for staying with the service animal. Visit Guest Services for more information

In Soak City, the guide places a service-animal relief area by the restrooms near Tropical Plunge. Owners must dispose of their animal’s waste; this does not remove the separate restrictions on animals entering water attractions or wet decks.
